# N26: Home: one primary at most, none when nothing is asked, in the first screen, and none of the words Home no longer says

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/12-home.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured.

## What it checks

Home's one primary, and quiet when quiet (docs/design/home/spec.md, HM1). [HOME-OWNER] On every day of two weeks for four of the demo's people, at a phone's and a computer's size: at most one primary button on Home, and none when there is no lead (the quiet line); the lead's button, and on a phone the first of your goals that needs attention, in the first screen (above the phone's tab bar at 390×844, above the fold at 1440×900); and Home never says "0 weeks", "None you’re in" or "You’re all set", nor links to a bare /goals or an old show= address.
